title: Agentic Wallet
tagline: An AI-powered onchain assistant built on Base, enabling seamless token swaps, DeFi interactions, and automated tasks through natural language. It integrates Autonome, Coinbase AgentKit, and Nillion SecretVault for secure, innovative, and user-friendly blockchain experiences. 🚀
description: Automatic Agent is an onchain AI agent hosted on Autonome providing quick, secure, and user-friendly access to onchain data and enabling seamless onchain operations like interacts with DeFi protocols, performs secure onchain actions, token deployment, and positions management etc. using Coinbase’s AgentKit behind the scenes. Everything is done with simple natural language interface and minimal friction.
how_its_made: Under the hood, Automatic Agent leverages Autonome’s TEE plugin for security, Coinbase’s AgentKit for seamless onchain interactions, combined with the Base network for speed and low-cost transactions, and Nillion’s SecretVault to protect sensitive data like agent memory and user interactions. We’re focused on combining innovation with robust security, ensuring trust for mainstream adoption.
